method: Linux netem in private user/network namespace; real TCP loss recovery, independent per-port-direction qdiscs
notes: Nominal netem RTT and per-direction rate; real TCP delay, loss, jitter and reordering in a private namespace.
Twelve key samples/profile: exploratory p50/p95/p99, not production-tail significance.
Echo uses actual in-page xterm DOM mutations; no local prediction or Playwright polling interval in timing.
Bulk bytes/messages include Noise, WebSocket framing and terminal controls; exclude TCP/IP, TLS and retransmissions.
Bulk/reconnect wall time includes automation dispatch and polling overhead; echo/first-output timing uses in-page renderer mutations.
Server network.outputFramedBytes is plaintext application framing, not full wire bytes.
CPU is total profile server process CPU; client Script/Task/decode measurements are timing proxies, not physical energy.
Heap is approximate end-profile Chromium JS heap. Server high-water RSS spans the whole process lifetime.
Continuous-output Ctrl-C waits for output already emitted; raw/compressed runs can emit different total bytes before stopping.
Session/client/workspace identifiers removed from this published artifact.
